findings.failure_scenario: The author manually edited `scripts/ci.sh` (which explicitly warns `Generated by bashrs - DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY`) instead of its source `scripts/ci.rs`. The manual edit restricts property tests to `-p aprender-core`, dropping the `property_tests` targets for 7 other crates in the workspace (including `aprender-db` and `aprender-graph`). Regressions in those crates will silently pass CI, and this manual change will be overwritten the next time `bashrs` runs.
findings.summary: Manual edit of generated scripts/ci.sh drops property tests for 7 workspace crates
findings.disposition: agreed and fixed in 436c15092: `cargo test --workspace --test property_tests` (8 targets, 151 tests listed); the header now says hand-maintained because scripts/ci.rs is not in the tree

findings.failure_scenario: Python's `__doc__` mechanism requires the docstring to be the very first logical line in the function body. Because the string literal follows executable statements (`witnesses = witnesses or {}` and `meta_c = meta.get(\"concurrency\")`), it is evaluated as a regular string literal and discarded. The function will have no docstring in documentation generators or `help()`.
findings.summary: The docstring for `_executor_side` is placed after executable statements, preventing it from being bound to `__doc__`
findings.disposition: agreed and fixed in 436c15092: the docstring is the first statement of _executor_side again (__doc__ is set)
